notes.title: Patch Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

A new patch is live, here what includes:

- Texts and GUI fixes

- Directional help for new quests

- Time Freeze ability bugs fixed

- Minor bug fixes 


Have fun! and if you have other feedback on what features you would like to see let us know!

- 

Also, we're working on:

- Camera Mode
- New upcoming DLC
- New unlockable items and weapons

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages - Soundtrack available and Patch 1.02!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!



The Soundtrack DLC is now available on Steam to purchase, check out the page!



It includes 50 pieces of music from the original game
[p align="start"](This Item will be updated with the release of every additional DLC.)



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991730/Mai_Child_of_Ages_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]

Also Patch 1.02 is now available and includes:



Fixes for Chinese Traditional and Chinese Simplified translations

Fixes for Japanese and Korean

Minor bug fixes



A new patch is on the way too and will include several bug fixes based on your feedback,

thank you so much for the support and keep us updates in the forum!



https://steamcommunity.com/app/3499550/discussions/
